component.name: apifast
component.summary: Test APIs from collections kept as files

description.p: apifast is a native, lightweight client for testing APIs. Collections are plain YAML files, one per request, compatible with Bruno, so they live in git like code.

ul.li: HTTP, GraphQL, WebSocket and gRPC requests
Environments and variables, with an encrypted vault for secrets
Assertions, captures and JavaScript scripts, and a collection runner
Import from Postman, Insomnia, OpenAPI and Bruno
The collection's git repository: what changed, field by field, and commits
The same engine from the command line: apifast send and apifast run
